description: Source code for GPIO driver implementation for Raspberry Pi Pico in Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, port control, interrupt handling, and initialization.

methods.name: gpio_rpi_configure
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin with specified flags, setting pull-up/down, direction, and open-drain mode.

methods.name: gpio_rpi_port_get_raw
methods.description: Retrieves the current raw value of all GPIO pins.

methods.name: gpio_rpi_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets multiple GPIO pins to specified values based on a mask.

methods.name: gpio_rpi_port_clear_bits_raw
methods.description: Clears specified GPIO pins to low.

methods.name: gpio_rpi_port_toggle_bits
methods.description: Toggles the state of specified GPIO pins.

methods.name: gpio_rpi_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt mode and trigger for a GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_rpi_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine handling GPIO interrupts.

methods.name: gpio_rpi_bank_init
methods.description: Initializes GPIO bank with interrupt configuration.
